actions.detail: Preflight and WorkPreflight froze the exact documentation, threat-model, STAR, premerge manifest, Harness Catalog, status board, handoff, security, and evidence contract under local P03-009 projection.

Synchronized Runtime architecture, migration/restore operations, Event persistence contract, machine schema, threat model, change summary and knowledge transfer strictly from Phase 3 code and evidence.
Promoted only controls 05, 11, 25 and 34 from contract_only to implemented using their Phase 3 S/I/D fragments; no normative field or other control status changed.
Added exact local Phase 3 closure adapters while keeping independent handoff/review, formal acceptance, push, merge and production status explicitly pending.
The first closure Security run correctly found one dangerous-command token, but the only source was the scanner's own newly added forbidden-pattern literal rather than a documentation example.
Encoded the same forbidden token as an equivalent character-class regex so self-source no longer matches while real unsafe examples remain detectable; no threshold or scanned file scope was reduced.

A second identical Security failure showed the first repair omitted the diagnostic receipt itself from the self-scan impact analysis. BLK-P03-089-security-self-scan records the full root cause, exclusions, repair, rollback, and recovery condition.
Removed the forbidden token from diagnostic metadata, retained the equivalent detection rule, and bound the resolved blocker into the closure workset and artifact manifest.

The complete Agent CI suite passed after closure repair with 212 unit/integration tests and 44 contract tests, plus formatting, lint, type, secret, license, dependency-audit, and clock-contract checks.
